Description: Verify all major dashboard sections load properly
Precondition: User logged in and on dashboard
Steps: 1. Navigate to dashboard; 2. Wait for load
Expected_Result: All sections visible: Overview; Scenarios; Personal Data; Settings; Feedback

Steps: 1. Click Scenarios tab; 2. Observe transition; 3. Click Personal Data tab; 4. Observe transition
Expected_Result: Each tab loads smoothly; content displays immediately

Steps: 1. Check dashboard header; 2. Look for user name; 3. Verify logout option
Expected_Result: User first name displays; logout button/menu present

Steps: 1. Observe overview section; 2. Look for metrics; 3. Verify numeric values
Expected_Result: Payment; Forgiveness; Tax; Balance; Remaining payments all visible

Description: Verify recalculation on personal data change
Steps: 1. Note current monthly payment; 2. Go to Personal Data; 3. Reduce income by 10%; 4. Save; 5. Return to Overview
Expected_Result: Monthly payment decreases proportionally; other metrics recalculate

Steps: 1. Scroll through Personal Data section; 2. Count visible fields; 3. Verify field labels
Expected_Result: Fields visible: First Name; Last Name; DOB; Email; Income; Employment; Marital Status

Precondition: User on Personal Data tab with initial data
Steps: 1. Select first editable field; 2. Clear and enter test value; 3. Click Save; 4. Refresh or navigate away; 5. Return to Personal Data
Expected_Result: Edited value persists after save; displays in field on return

Steps: 1. Click email field; 2. Enter invalid-email; 3. Attempt save
Expected_Result: Save button disabled OR error message displays; invalid format rejected

Description: Verify field can be cleared and re-entered
Steps: 1. Find text input field; 2. Clear completely; 3. Re-enter new value; 4. Verify in field
Expected_Result: Field accepts new value after clear; displays entered text

Steps: 1. Locate age/DOB field; 2. Attempt to enter -5 or past date; 3. Try to save
Expected_Result: Save disabled OR validation error; negative/future dates rejected

Description: Verify ability to add multiple household members
Steps: 1. Locate Family Members section; 2. Click Add Member; 3. Enter spouse data; 4. Save
Expected_Result: New record added; displays in list; persists after save

Description: Verify ability to modify household member data
Precondition: User with multiple family members on Personal Data
Steps: 1. Click Edit on family member; 2. Change name; 3. Save
Expected_Result: Changes persist; member record updates; other members unaffected

Description: Verify ability to remove household member
Precondition: User with multiple family members on Personal Data
Steps: 1. Click Delete on family member; 2. Confirm deletion
Expected_Result: Record removed from list; not displayed on refresh; dependent calculations recalculate

Steps: 1. Navigate to Settings; 2. Observe all controls
Expected_Result: Multiple toggles/dropdowns visible; labels clear

Description: Verify setting toggle saves and persists
Steps: 1. Toggle notification switch; 2. Click Save; 3. Navigate away; 4. Return to Settings
Expected_Result: Toggle state persists; matches saved value on return

Description: Verify user feedback on successful save
Steps: 1. Change setting value; 2. Click Save; 3. Observe notification area
Expected_Result: Success message displays; fade-out after 3 seconds

Steps: 1. Click Currency dropdown; 2. Select EUR; 3. Save; 4. Return
Expected_Result: EUR selected and persists; all monetary values display in EUR

Precondition: User without phone number on Settings tab
Steps: 1. Locate SMS notification toggle; 2. Attempt to enable
Expected_Result: Toggle disabled OR error message; requires phone number first

Steps: 1. Click scenario dropdown; 2. Observe options
Expected_Result: Dropdown opens; multiple scenario options visible

Precondition: User on Scenarios tab with multiple scenarios
Steps: 1. Select Scenario B from dropdown; 2. Observe content change; 3. Verify calculations
Expected_Result: Dashboard content updates; calculations match Scenario B data

Test_Name: Save new scenario with current data
Description: Verify ability to create named scenarios
Steps: 1. Enter scenario name; 2. Click Save Scenario; 3. Reload; 4. Select saved scenario
Expected_Result: New scenario appears in dropdown; data preserved; selection works

Description: Verify ability to remove custom scenarios
Precondition: User with saved custom scenarios on Scenarios tab
Steps: 1. Select custom scenario; 2. Click Delete; 3. Confirm; 4. Reload
Expected_Result: Scenario removed from dropdown; system scenarios remain

Steps: 1. Try to access delete for system scenario (e.g. Default)
Expected_Result: Delete button disabled OR grayed out; system scenarios protected

Precondition: User on Overview with known profile
Steps: 1. Load specific persona profile; 2. Check displayed payment; 3. Compare to expected
Expected_Result: Displayed payment matches calculated amount ±$0.01

Steps: 1. Observe tax estimate display; 2. Verify numeric value
Expected_Result: Tax bomb amount ≥ $0; formatted as currency

Test_Name: Forgiveness date in future or N/A
Steps: 1. Check forgiveness date display; 2. Verify format
Expected_Result: Date format MM/DD/YYYY OR "N/A"; if date; then > today

Test_Name: Total debt equals sum of loans
Precondition: User with multiple loans on Overview
Steps: 1. Note total balance; 2. Sum individual loans; 3. Compare
Expected_Result: Total balance = Sum of individual loan balances

Steps: 1. Note forgiveness date; 2. Calculate months from today; 3. Compare to displayed
Expected_Result: Remaining Payments = (Forgiveness Date - Today) / 30 days ±1

Test_Name: Feedback form displays textarea and button
Steps: 1. Navigate to Feedback; 2. Observe form
Expected_Result: Textarea visible; placeholder text; Submit button visible

Steps: 1. Enter Test feedback message; 2. Click Submit; 3. Observe result
Expected_Result: Success message displays OR form resets; feedback recorded

Steps: 1. Leave textarea empty; 2. Click Submit
Expected_Result: Submit button disabled OR error message; empty submission blocked

Steps: 1. Click Category dropdown; 2. Select Feature Request; 3. Submit feedback
Expected_Result: Category selection persists; submitted with feedback

Steps: 1. Attempt to enter 1001 characters; 2. Observe behavior
Expected_Result: Textarea stops input at 1000 chars OR warning displays

Steps: 1. Record initial payment; 2. Edit income; 3. Save; 4. Check overview
Expected_Result: Overview metrics recalculate; payment amount changes

Steps: 1. Enable dark mode; 2. Navigate to Personal Data; 3. Check theme; 4. Go to Feedback
Expected_Result: Dark mode applied consistently across all sections

Steps: 1. Record Scenario A data; 2. Switch to Scenario B; 3. Verify all sections update
Expected_Result: All sections reflect Scenario B data; no carryover from A

Test_Name: Tab key navigates all interactive elements
Steps: 1. Press Tab repeatedly; 2. Verify focus moves; 3. Press Shift+Tab; 4. Verify reverse navigation
Expected_Result: Focus visible; all interactive elements reachable; logical order

Test_Name: Form errors use accessible alert role
Steps: 1. Enter invalid input; 2. Check for [role="alert"]; 3. Verify error text
Expected_Result: Error message has role="alert" OR aria-describedby; screen readers announce

Steps: 1. Check text colors; 2. Check button colors; 3. Verify backgrounds
Expected_Result: All text AA contrast ratio ≥ 4.5:1; buttons ≥ 3:1
